content: उपतप् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To make warm, heat; उपतप्तोदका नद्यः <ls>Rām.</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 65</ls> (where it means to pain also). .²2 To feel pain, become sick; आहिताग्निश्चेदुपतपेत् <ls>Āśval.</ls> .²3 To afflict, befall (as a sickness); sometimes used impersonally. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be pained, become ill, be afflicted with; इत्यपूर्वमुपतप्यतेऽस्माभिः <ls>Mv. 2</ls>; so दुःखेनोपतप्यते <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To be emaciated with penance, practise penance; उपतप्यामहे तपः <ls>Av.</ls> . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To kindle, ignite, burn; न नो गृहाणामुप तीतपासि <ls>Av. 6. 32. 1</ls>. .²2 To torment, hurt, pain. .²3 To offend, oppress. .²4 To mortify the body by penance.
